name: Caught!
objectiveText: Kill 8 Dark Iron Geologists and bring 15 pieces of Silk Cloth to the person locked in the outhouse in Searing Gorge .   Dark Iron Geologist slain  ( 8 ) Silk Cloth  ( 15 )

comments.body: The droprate of silk off the nearby dwarves is horrible. I suggest that you bring silk prior to getting this quest. If you decide to clear the camp over and over, don't forget about the second camp to the north along the road. Clear one camp then run back to the other and repeat the cycle for minimum downtime.

This quest is gotten from the Outhouse at 65,62, it looks like a wooden cubicle.

The camp of Dark Iron Geologists is at the Grimeslit Dig Site (60,63). I normally keep Silk in my bag so that's not my main worry.

The Geologists at the Grimesilt Dig Site are in three groups, 2 each in front of the tents and 2 more up a slight rise behind the tents. The 3 at each tent are linked and the geologists are casters, so you can't pull them. But you can pull the third mob at each tent - a Dark Iron Watchman.

First, kill all the roaming golems or they will surprise you with their aggro range. Then pull each of the Watchmen far enough away so you are out of range of the Geologists. Kill the Watchmen, then kill the casters.

You should be able to do the entire quest at the camp because all the mobs respawn quickly, including the golems. Not much silk drops (not 15 at any rate), so be prepared to get that elsewhere. Pretty decent XP at level 47 (Shadow Priest).

the outhouse is on the hill above the grimesilt digsite.  approach the digsite from the tanner camp and you will see a hill leading up behind the digsite.  follow that hill to find the outhouse.  It is guarded by a single tempered war golem (lvl 45-47.)  Also, note that it doesn't show up on the minimap when you are close, and it doesn't have the floating question mark, so you have to keep your eyes open for it.
You can do both Key to Freedom and Locked In although logically you should be able to do only one.
